definition: Joseph Weizenbaum (8 January 1923 – 5 March 2008) was a German-American computer scientist and a professor at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology.
details: Built the first chatbot (ELIZA) in 1966, pioneering natural language processing and sparking early debates on human-AI interaction. He is the namesake of the Weizenbaum Award and the Weizenbaum Institute.

explainer.lead: Joseph Weizenbaum was a German-American computer scientist (1923–2008). His work spans computer science.
explainer.knownFor: Notable works include Computer Power and Human Reason: From Judgment to Calculation, SLIP and ELIZA.
